lcc_original: 地開了口，從你手裏收取了你兄弟的血了；如今你，你是受咒詛、須離開這地的。
notes: Initial 地 left untagged: UNV assigns H127 only to 這地 at clause end; followed same convention in LCC
LCC 須離開 (must leave) is an interpretive rendering of H4480 (מִן, from) expressing directional separation — tagged accordingly before 這地<WH0127>
Emphatic doublet 你，你是: H859 (אַתָּה) attached to first 你 only; copula 是 has no Hebrew equivalent
Aspect particles 了×2, attributive 的, and punctuation 、；have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
Both {<WAH0834>} and {<WAH0853>} implicit markers preserved: LCC has no explicit words for אֲשֶׁר or אֵת either
LCC 收取 (receive/take) clearly corresponds to UNV 接受 / H3947 (לָקַח); tags placed after content word before particle 了
